answer: This local teaching experiment demonstrates safe database access by using parameterized queries — binding tenant, habitat, and limit as separate parameters rather than interpolating them into SQL strings. It runs against an in-memory SQLite fixture with query-only mode enabled, ensuring no data can be modified. The fixed report returns only pre-approved fields (habitat and count), scoped to a server-owned tenant context to prevent cross-tenant data leakage.
